layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV serialization for record exports
Write record exports to the export folder
Add integration test for denied exports
Document CSV export in usage guide

graderOnly: The repository has exactly one branch, release-work; there is no main or master branch, so a default-branch comparison has no base to compare against.

The development plan records the pre-cycle baseline commit 'Document listing and filtering records' (Plan Notes) and the three implementation commits that follow it ('Add CSV serialization for record exports', 'Write record exports to the export folder', 'Add administrator-only CSV export route'), each also cited in its step's self-check. The verification, review, and documentation records cite the later commits they assessed.
The working tree is clean: git diff, git diff --cached, and git status are empty. All of the cycle's work lives in commits between the pre-cycle commit and HEAD ('Record CSV export final review').

Current assessments cover the assembled committed work: every content identity cited by the verification, implementation review, documentation, and final review records matches the current tree, and the final review assessed the assembled deliverable. No material discrepancy exists, so a correct run can pass the synchronization gate.

notes: Built on export-project (not export-synchronizing) so the development plan can record the pre-cycle commit and the implementation commits, and so the implementation is split into three commits, giving a real multi-commit range. Top-level branch release-work makes git init start on it, so the repository has no main or master. Layers 50-76 reproduce export-synchronizing's cycle with these changes: 56-plan Plan Notes name the pre-cycle baseline ${COMMIT:Document listing and filtering records}; 58/60/62 commit DEV-001 (csvCell, toCsv, unit tests), DEV-002 (exportFileName, writeExport, .gitignore exports/), and DEV-003 (route, app options, test:integration script, two-test integration file) separately; 64-complete marks the plan COMPLETE, each step's self-check cites its commit, and Plan Notes list baseline plus the three implementation commits in order. 66 adds the denied-export integration test; 68 verification, 70 implementation review, 72 guide, 74 documentation, 76 final review mirror export-synchronizing (verification and documentation cite the route commit instead of the base's single implementation commit). Final file contents equal export-synchronizing's. State SYNCHRONIZING, FORWARD from REVIEWING_FINAL, tree clean (git diff empty), no synchronization record. All cited COMMIT/BLOB identities match HEAD, so current assessments cover the assembled work and no discrepancy exists.
